import os
from openai import OpenAI

client = OpenAI(base_url="https://api.tokenfactory.nebius.com/v1", api_key=os.environ["NEBIUS_API_KEY"])

MODEL = 'nvidia/Nemotron-3-Ultra-550b-a55b'

SYSTEM = 'Is this text message spam or a normal message (ham)?\n\nOutput format: One label, lowercase\n\nReply with the answer only.'
FEW_SHOT = []


def run(text: str) -> str:
    messages = [{"role": "system", "content": SYSTEM}, *FEW_SHOT, {"role": "user", "content": text}]
    r = client.chat.completions.create(
        model=MODEL, messages=messages, temperature=0, max_tokens=248,
        extra_body={"chat_template_kwargs": {"enable_thinking": THINKING}},
    )
    if r.choices[0].finish_reason == "length":
        raise RuntimeError("ran out of tokens before answering")
    return r.choices[0].message.content.strip()

# Ask two cheap setups in parallel; pay for the expensive one only when they disagree.
# check() is this task's checker, used here to ask 'is answer A as good as answer B?'.
import asyncio

CHEAP_A = {'model': 'nvidia/Nemotron-3_5-Lightning', 'thinking': False}  # + its tuned prompt
CHEAP_B = {'model': 'nvidia/NVIDIA-Nemotron-3-Nano-30B-A3B', 'thinking': False}  # + its tuned prompt
FALLBACK = {'model': 'nvidia/Nemotron-3-Ultra-550b-a55b', 'thinking': False}


async def run(text: str) -> str:
    a, b = await asyncio.gather(ask(CHEAP_A, text), ask(CHEAP_B, text))
    score, _ = check(a, b, text)
    return a if score >= 0.999 else await ask(FALLBACK, text)

FEW_SHOT = []


def run(text: str) -> str:
    messages = [{"role": "system", "content": SYSTEM}, *FEW_SHOT, {"role": "user", "content": text}]
    r = client.chat.completions.create(
        model=MODEL, messages=messages, temperature=0, max_tokens=248,
        extra_body={"chat_template_kwargs": {"enable_thinking": THINKING}},
    )
    if r.choices[0].finish_reason == "length":
        raise RuntimeError("ran out of tokens before answering")
    return r.choices[0].message.content.strip()
